articles.title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.
articles.content: Test using prompts with unique, trackable secrets proves that data doesn't stay private.
articles.titleZh: 研究人员在人工智能供应链中植入了 200 万只“金丝雀”。一场隐私灾难浮出水面。
articles.contentZh: 使用包含唯一且可追踪的秘密的提示进行测试，结果证明数据无法保持私密性。

articles.title: Man hired by Russia spied on Silicon Valley tech and defense company, feds say
articles.content: 25-year-old accused of stalking employees at coffee shop and in an "aggressive" car pursuit.
articles.titleZh: 联邦调查局称，一名受雇于俄罗斯的男子曾对硅谷的科技和国防公司进行间谍活动
articles.contentZh: 25岁男子被指控在咖啡店尾随员工，并“咄咄逼人”地驾车追逐。

articles.title: How to tell a cyberattack from a plain old outage
articles.content: When everything goes down, don’t assume it’s a cyberattack.
articles.titleZh: 如何区分网络攻击和普通的停机故障
articles.contentZh: 当一切都瘫痪时，不要想当然地认为这是网络攻击。

articles.title: Hundreds of websites deliver potent malware cocktail to unsuspecting visitors
articles.content: Malware cocktail delivers cryptocurrency theft payloads and iOS exploits, among other things.
articles.titleZh: 数百个网站向毫无戒心的访客提供强大的恶意软件组合
articles.contentZh: 恶意软件组合会传播加密货币盗窃载荷和 iOS 漏洞利用等内容。

articles.title: Kodak’s next collectible is a tiny digital photo frame that doubles as a tracker
articles.content: After expanding its Charmera collection with a Millennium Edition featuring Y2K-inspired designs earlier this year, Reto's follow-up to its tiny Kodak camera is an equally small digital photo frame you can use to display your shots. But while the Charmera's usefulness stopped at snapping grainy photos and terrible videos, the Kodak SlideTag goes one step […]
articles.titleZh: 柯达的下一款收藏品是一款小巧的数码相框，同时兼具追踪功能
articles.contentZh: 今年早些时候，Reto在Charmera系列中推出了以Y2K为灵感的千禧版，随后又推出了与迷你柯达相机同样小巧的数码相框，可用于展示您的照片。然而，虽然Charmera的用途仅限于拍摄颗粒感较强的照片和质量糟糕的视频，但柯达SlideTag更进一步……

articles.title: We haven’t seen the last of the major tech outages
articles.content: Over the last week or so, we have seen a nationwide FAA ground stop, a multi-day Outlook outage that brought entire companies to a standstill, and a banking outage at JPMorgan Chase. But the consensus is that there are more to come. Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton told CNN: "The American people should be […]
articles.titleZh: 我们还没有看到最后一次重大技术中断
articles.contentZh: 在过去一周左右的时间里，我们经历了美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）的全国性停飞令、导致整家公司陷入停顿的持续多日Outlook服务中断，以及摩根大通的银行业务中断。但人们普遍认为，今后还会有更多此类事件发生。国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿（Jay Clayton）对CNN表示：“美国人民应该……”
